public.text: The section allows interactions not yet specified to transaction level, but does not explain whether such interactions can be treated as conformant or procured safely.
public.suggestedRevision: Define maturity states such as conceptual interaction, specified interaction, testable transaction, and certified profile. Restrict formal conformance claims to interactions with adequate normative specifications and tests.
